selected_entries_recorded_in_registry.description_on_form: Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust (IT Collection LLC, Holding Company in New York NY)) (royalty income for period March 9, 2017 - May 31, 2017)
selected_entries_recorded_in_registry.intermediary_note: The valued form line is the Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust holding. IT Collection LLC is the holding company named within that line and is recorded as the registry counterparty entity (cp_entity_0007). The Business Trust is the intermediary; per the Fork B single-relationship decision it is not modeled as a separate cp_entity this pass. The 'Over $50,000,000' value is the forcing case for the new value shape `floor` (see docs/methodology.md, 'Value shape: floor').
selected_entries_recorded_in_registry.value_vs_income_note: The registry stores the asset value bracket on the relationship's value object (shape=floor, floor=50000000) and the income-type/income-amount strings here in the filing payload. This matches the existing pattern (e.g. cp_rel_0009 income recorded in cp_filing_0003.interest_disclosed). The two brackets are not conflated: only the asset value is open-ended; the income amount ($1,000,001 - $5,000,000) is an ordinary bounded range.

_open_questions_surfaced.convention_3_spousal_imputation_deferred: Fork B decision C (spousal imputation, schema-level) was NOT applied this pass. The decision was written against an inaccurate model of the schema: it specs a new `derives_from_relationship_id` field and a `relationship_type` enum, but the registry already models imputed edges via Value.imputation_source + shape=imputed + interest_type=spousal_imputed (see cp_rel_0004, cp_rel_0007). It also misidentified cp_rel_0005/0006 as imputed-from-Jared edges; they are direct ownership edges. The Westminster spousal-imputed edge and the Ivanka OPO re-sourcing are held pending maintainer decision on whether to reuse the existing imputation_source mechanism or add the parallel field.
_open_questions_surfaced.filer_already_in_registry: The Fork B handoffs anticipated adding Ivanka as a new person record (persons 3 -> 4). She already exists as cp_person_0002, created when Jared Kushner's 2018/2019 annuals disclosed her in their spouse sections. cp_filing_0004.filer_id points at cp_person_0002; no new person record was created. Persons count is unchanged at 3.
_open_questions_surfaced.cp_filing_0003_over_50m_backfill: Five 'Over $50,000,000' lines were held back from cp_filing_0003 pending a value shape for open-ended upper bounds. The `floor` shape now exists; those five lines are eligible for backfill under a separate registry pass.
_open_questions_surfaced.selective_capture_gap: Ivanka's 2017 new-entrant 278 surfaces many entities in PROJECT.md scope that are not in the registry because cp_filing_0001/0002 captured only Westminster Management LLC and Ivanka OPO LLC selectively. Examples on this filing's spouse-side Part 6: Quadro Partners (d/b/a Cadre), BFPS Ventures LLC, JCK Cadre LLC, Kushner Credit Opportunity Fund LLC, 666 Fifth Management LLC. Not added this pass; flagged for a selective-capture audit / backfill pass.

categories.rationale: Mortgages on the filer's primary personal residence; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(i). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Loans secured by a personal motor vehicle, household furniture, or appliances (unless the loan exceeds the item's purchase price); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(ii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Credit card and revolving charge account balances under $10,000 outstanding to a single creditor at the end of the reporting period; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Interpersonal loans from a spouse, parent, sibling, or child of the filer (natural-person counterparty only); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iv). Does NOT apply to entity-mediated debt (e.g., loans from a family-controlled trust or LLC), which are written as normal debt_instrument_owed edges per Convention 5. No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).
